description: Western Province - Annaincing that the By-Law relating to Charges on Parking of Three-weeter Taxis drafted by the Kaduwela Minicipal Council was adapted by the Western Province Provincial Council
categorisation: This gazette notification primarily concerns the adoption of a municipal by-law ("By-law relating to Regularizing, Controlling and Levying Charges on Parking of Three-wheeler Taxis") under the Municipal Councils Ordinance and Provincial Councils Act. While it mentions the Chief Minister's approval and role, the core content is about establishing a legal/regulatory framework for parking regulations, not about government personnel changes or structural reorganization. This fits Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory) as it deals with regulatory matters and statutory instruments.
